item.title: Judge removed from Texas track meet stabbing case as defendant Karmelo Anthony seeks a new trial
item.description: The trial judge who presided over the case of Texas teenager convicted of fatally stabbing a 17-year-old athlete at a high school track meet was ordered removed from the case as the defendant seeks a new trial and appeals his conviction.
